system.description:
• Effect: Recall a previously cast 1st-level spell once per day via an Intelligence check (DC 10, the Easy tier), casting it again without expending a slot. A specific spell can only be recalled once per day.
  • From 24th level: works for previously cast 2nd-level spells

activities.name: Perfect Recall
activities.text: Make a DC 10 Intelligence check to recast a previously cast 1st-level spell (2nd-level from 24th) without spending a slot.
